text: The dream is not to have a Lambo.
The dream is to have a mother who isn't worried about hospital bills.
The dream is to be able to travel around the world because there's a place you want to see before you die.
The dream is to not have that depression on a Sunday night because you have work on a Monday morning.
The dream is to have a car that works and if it breaks down you can afford to pay it.
And to achieve this dream, you don't have to go and die in a ditch in Ukrain.
You don't have to climb Mount Everest.
You have to open up a laptop and type.
